findings.desc: Coverage is missing/misleading for the session_brief/next and fallback/no-owner-self-sign acceptance surface. The focused smoke asserts buildNextSteps(...).TEST and done_prepare safe command separation, but it never invokes createSessionHandlers(...).session_brief/next or the CLI next path. The actual TEST next path summarizes DONE row hints from done-oracle/session.ts, and the review-assurance formatter still emits autopilot_review_submit in its recovery text; review-escalation failure text likewise names autopilot_review_submit/review_escalation_fallback_set. Because the smoke does not cover session_brief/next, it would not catch owner-visible self-sign command exposure outside done_prepare. The smoke also only exercises the fallback-eligible positive case and does not assert the not-eligible/not-applicable case omits fallback writer guidance, so CHK-001 edge fallback eligibility is not fully covered.

review_escalation_status builds canonical review-escalation guidance but drops it from human text output, rendering only floor guidance at packages/main/src/handlers/review-escalation.ts:111. A story whose canonical review escalation predicate fires without the floor predicate, such as first-round countable findings on non-code material or an explicit high-risk policy fact, will not receive the new legal-writer, fallback, and cannot-auto-sign guidance on the primary status surface. The smoke fixture at packages/main/src/tasks/review-assurance-surfacing-smoke.ts:150 does not seed first-round findings and only asserts the floor reason code, so this canonical escalation path is untested.
